title: A considered explanation need not be perfect

captions.physics: Hinting at an attitude not understood
captions.energy: Sharing considered understanding of words heard

meaning: You can hint at an attitude not understood and share considered understanding of words heard, feeling a need to gather personal meaning without explaining everything immediately.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Moon in the physical position can appear in a hint about an attitude not understood. The Hermit in energy supports a wish to consider what was heard and share understanding gained. The Hermit in emotions brings a need to gather a personal meaning of the exchange. Readiness to offer a considered explanation differs from an experience still needing reflection. An unclear response does not become reliable knowledge of the other person’s interest.

Suppose a story is interrupted by “I seem to be talking into thin air”, although no direct question about attention was asked. You can explain which thought actually stayed with you and how it was understood. **A considered response can be substantial and incomplete**. These words may prompt wanting to reconsider your own account. A pause need not close conversation: what has not yet formed into an answer can be named. Clarifying one meaning does not require immediate proof of understanding every detail completely.

Difficulty arises if permission to speak is postponed until a flawless inward conclusion. Both answers may remain unknown despite actual interest. Constructive Hermit energy helps share what has already been considered while preserving an honest limit around the rest. You can voice one understandable thought and acknowledge incompleteness; depth is not measured by finality, while lacking a full account makes an earlier guess about indifference neither more accurate nor compulsory to accept.
